about.title: Potential Business Owner
about.bio: I don't just write code; I build businesses. With over 15 years of experience in distributed systems and product development, I partner with founders to turn vision into valuable technical assets. I bring the discipline of enterprise architecture to the agility of a startup.

services.title: Fractional CTO / VPE
services.description: Strategic technical leadership for startups and scale-ups. I help define roadmap, hire key talent, and establish engineering culture.

services.title: Architecture Modernization
services.description: Comprehensive audit of existing systems with a roadmap for migration to modern, scalable patterns (microservices, serverless, edge).

services.title: Technical Due Diligence
services.description: Deep-dive assessment of code quality, scalability, and security for investors and M&A activities.

projects.title: Core Banking Modernization
projects.description: Strangler Fig migration of legacy Oracle Banking Platform monolith to Go microservices, reducing latency by 56% and enabling zero-downtime deployments.

projects.title: Automated KYC/AML Platform
projects.description: Orchestration engine integrating 13+ identity providers (Persona, Experian) to automate 90% of verifications, reducing onboarding time from days to minutes.

projects.title: Education Financing & BNPL
projects.description: Digital lending platform for education financing featuring inflation-adjusted loans, eNACH automated collections, and real-time eligibility checks.
